meta_notes.b1_as_shipped: B1 runs AS SHIPPED per exp43c's SS5.4 row (false/true): the matched initialisation satisfies F3 (twin collapse 0.555/0.580 <= 0.60) yet meets the L1 gate in 0/8 configs, while B1-as-shipped passed the SS5.2 memorisation control (3/8 configs >= 0.95 on 64 items). The asymmetry survives its strongest challenge; the init audit (results_exp43b_b1_init_audit.json) and exp43c (results_exp43c.json) are reported alongside every comparative number here as the reason a reader should believe it.
meta_notes.b3_label: UNTRAINED INSTRUMENT on this rung (doc 24 SS4 + F5): B3 failed the SS5.2 memorisation control 0/8 at exactly 0.500 -- L1 twins are bag-identical, so a bag model is structurally blind to the rung. Its numbers are recorded for the sentinel value only and enter NO comparison.
meta_notes.a1_sentinel_rule: leak sentinel: Lemma 1 (exp43a analysis W1) pins SWAP-commuting blocks to exactly 50% on twin pairs; execution resolution of 'must remain at chance': every seed's best-val test accuracy must be <= 0.55 (the chance+5pp convention used by C2/C4).
meta_notes.b2_augmentation: name augmentation ON for training (doc 22 SS4 protocol); the exp43c disable was control-only
meta_notes.tier_q_rule: tier_q_passed = (A2_vs_B1 one-sided p < 0.05) AND content_earned_A2 -- the exp42 convention; combining with C1 can only make the claim harder
meta_notes.tier_q_prime_scope: doc 24 SS7 (frozen with the criterion): A3 is full-SU(4) and has NO structure-matched classical counterpart in the arm set, so a positive tier-q' licenses only 'the full-SU(4) block class learns this rung where the matched classical class does not, at matched budget' -- NOT a quantum-advantage reading. This caveat travels with the number (Rule 5).
meta_notes.tier_s_rule: tier_s_passed = A2_vs_B2 AND B1_vs_B2 both p<0.05; B3 excluded per F5 (untrained instrument); B2_generous not in the doc 23 arm set
meta_notes.pre_registered_interpretation: doc 24 SS7 (pre-registered): Phase 1 ran only A3 and B1, so whether A2 learns L1 is unknown. If A2 fails L1 while A3 succeeds, the finding is about EXPRESSIVITY (universal vs restricted block class), not about quantum-vs-classical, and tier-q is reported as failed on its own terms.
